_doc: Where the strike universe comes from. source=audiences reads the saved segment below at build time (0 credits) and REGENERATES data/tam_accounts.csv, data/sellers.csv and merges data/triggers.csv; source=csv leaves the files as they are. Shape the universe by editing the segment filter in Clay, not by editing CSVs. Added 2026-09-11 (live loop spec, motions/live_loop/LIVE_LOOP_SPEC.md).

segment.name: TAM Strike Universe (engine)
segment._note: Created once by universe_from_audiences.py --create-segment; id written back here; --update-segment pushes this config's filter to it. Filter as of Sep 11 2026 (tightened on Dallas's go): SF Account Type = Prospect, employee_count >= 1000, industry in icp_industries, and (6sense 6QA true OR heat lane rep/cohort). include_platform_reads=true widens it to any CC platform read within read_max_age_days (354 on Sep 11; intent-only was about 170). include_facts_backed=true keeps any Prospect with a fresh filing-grade fact in data/account_facts.json in the universe regardless of the filter. Edit the filter in Clay or here, then --update-segment.

agent_ratio._doc: Contact-centre agents as a share of employees, used ONLY when data/account_facts.json has no public contact-centre figure. Always labelled 'banded ESTIMATE' in source. Centene precedent 0.16 accepted Sep 5 2026.

exclude_domains.navient.com: loan servicing outsourced to a third party in 2024; contact-centre motion no longer applies (Sep 11 2026)
